function findInsertPositionInArray(sortedArray, value, compareFn) {
  let left = 0;
  let right = sortedArray.length;
  while (left < right) {
    const mid = Math.floor((left + right) / 2);
    const comparison = compareFn(sortedArray[mid], value);
    if (comparison < 0) {
      left = mid + 1;
    } else {
      right = mid;
    }
  };
  return left;
}
